answer: Smart-meter attestation ties each identity to a real household's power use. On registration, the utility signs 90 days of meter readings showing daily consumption, and one meter backs only one identity. A farm wanting 100 fakes needs 100 metered homes at about $150 to connect plus $180 in bills each, $33,000 in all. Meters serving a lagoon fishing village, an olive grove's pump, and a pigment workshop all leave patterns no script can fake.
